body: Chief: both index sweeps today were your mote-sync commits (62f926e swept the codec slice, 0911034 swept P0-1). Content was identical to acked candidates both times so nothing is broken, but from now on: git add .mote/ops && git commit -- .mote/ops (explicit pathspec), never a bare git commit with a shared index. Also please run git status before each sync and leave any foreign staged files alone.
